Honest identities pay once. A new identity pays a 60-unit genesis tax. Each clean epoch returns 10% as fee credit. After 10 honest epochs it is fully offset.
Fake identities pay every time. A vertex of 1,000 clones pays 60,000 up front. The velvet glove comes off fast: 30% get caught, 18,000 units burned.
The walnut math: honest cost is 60 once, refunded over time. Fake cost is 60,000 sunk plus 18,000 burned per batch. Forgery never breaks even.
